newsitem.title: USA: Aztar Corp sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Aztar Corp sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Aztar Corp said on Thursday it expects to report a loss for the third quarter after pre-opening expenses related to its expansion of its Atlantic City, New Jersey property are factored in.
In a statement the company said it expects to report earnings before pre-opening expenses at approximately break-even compared with earnings of $0.11 a share before pre-opening expenses a year ago.
The company said it had expected higher levels of cash flow in the third quarter from its Atlantic City Tropicana property following the completion of an expansion of the property in early July.

"While revenue increases did occur, start-up costs and continuing marketing pressures resulting from additional casino supply throughout the Atlantic City market severely impacted operating margins," the company said." Consequently, operating cash flow at the Tropicana in the third quarter will fall below last year's level.
According to First Call, the company had been expected to report a profit of $0.21 a share in the third quarter before pre-opening expenses.

"We continue to be optimistic about Atlantic City and the competitive position of the Tropicana," said Chairman and Chief Executive Paul Rubeli. "Utilization of our expanded room base and casino will permit us to continue to increase revenues. Operating cash flow margins should improve significantly with the elimination of start-up inefficiencies and with modifications to certain of our marketing programs. We believe that the Atlantic City Tropicana is in a good position to generate substantial increases in cash flow going forward."
The expansion includes a 604-room hotel tower as well as extensive improvements and addition of capacity to the casino.
